dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave spline from the posterior ridge to the apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.5 times the vertical height.
